02 — THE CLUB

AN EAST END CLUB
WITH REAL HISTORY.

Glasgow Phoenix is a community amateur boxing club based on French Street in Dalmarnock — part of the East End’s boxing tradition, affiliated to Boxing Scotland, the sport’s governing body in Scotland.

The club has a strong history of developing successful boxers, and the same coaching goes to everyone who walks in — juniors from ten, adults of any age, and anyone training for fitness.
